habit_scope: Paper hold points: drawings accepted, building permit in hand, inspections scheduled before the work they cover. ORNL SITE INSPECTIONS DURING CONSTRUCTION; CMHC Ch2 Fig 2 (Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC). Not legal advice. Not a stamp. Not a skip-inspection. 1–2 story wood SFR.
how_it_is_done: This phase is hold points, not a how-to for the trades. Confirm AHJ. CMHC is Canadian / NBC — not IRC. Do not copy the Canadian permit menu as a US habit.

CMHC Fig 2 pre-construction: Zoning and Environmental Approvals → Site Plan, Working Drawings and Specifications → Building Permit (and, in Canada, plumbing / heating / electrical / utility / health-unit permits as they apply). Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC.
ORNL: Acquire building permits after plans, specs, bid package, and contract (PLANS, CONTRACTS, AND BUILDING PERMITS).

Schedule inspections so you do not sit. CMHC Ch2: 'It is important to schedule inspections to avoid lengthy delays. Determine exactly what work must be completed and how much notice is required prior to calling for a particular inspection.' 'Municipalities may not inspect the work at every stage of construction; however, most will inspect when the foundations, framing, plumbing and electrical, insulation and exterior finishes are complete.' Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC. That is not a skip-inspection — it is 'ask the AHJ which holds they run.'

ORNL SITE INSPECTIONS DURING CONSTRUCTION (checklist): After excavation and before concrete is poured for the footings; After the footings have been poured before foundation wall construction; After foundation construction and dampproofing before rough framing; After rough framing; After rough plumbing and electrical; After insulation installation before drywall and backfilling in case of exterior insulation; Final. Dual-use design and field (ORNL Ch 2 checklists). HUD: IRC so builder + official can inspect without a PE; PE when tables fail.

CMHC construction-stage names (Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC): Excavation and Footings Inspection; Pre-Backfill Inspection; Framing Inspection; Sewers, Drains, Water Service and Underground Plumbing Inspection; Electrical Service Inspection; Plumbing, Heating and Electrical Rough-In Inspection; Insulation and Air/Vapour Barrier Inspection; Pre-Occupancy / Final Plumbing, Heating and Electrical; Completion Inspection (Interior and Exterior); Certificate of Occupancy. Do not copy this list as IRC. Use it as 'the book printed a hold-point sequence — ask the AHJ for theirs.'
Warranty-program extra registration and inspection may apply in some areas (CMHC). Canadian — confirm AHJ; not IRC.
HOA, impact fees, and special-inspection agreements are silent in these books. Gap gap-P02-hoa-impact-special-inspect. Do not invent them as Methods.
Nothing in the ground until the paper is real. CMHC: excavation proceeds once building layout has been completed (Ch2 Stages) and the pre-construction permits exist (Fig 2). Confirm AHJ.
trades: CMHC: municipal building officials / plans examiner; building official to inspect footings, foundation, municipal service connections. Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC.
ORNL: construction inspection checklists. HUD: builder + official; PE when tables fail. AF&PA: building inspector enforces the illustrated procedures. No crew size.
tools_equipment: Not a tool list. The paper is the work.
inspection_hold_points: Building permit acquired before construction (ORNL; CMHC Fig 2). Confirm AHJ.
Footing inspection after excavation and before the pour (ORNL). No frozen subgrade (ORNL FOOTINGS) — that hold is also P04/P05.
Do not skip the AHJ's list because CMHC said some municipalities do not inspect every stage. Ask. Not a skip-inspection.
PE when IRC/HUD tables fail (HUD). Not a stamp on a table house.
when_this_beats_habit: This is the habit. Books did not file competing permit Methods. AHJ variation is the rule, not an alt Method.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: Copying CMHC's Canadian permit menu as IRC. Treating 'municipalities may not inspect every stage' as a skip-inspection. Inventing HOA / impact-fee / special-inspector Methods the books did not print. Giving legal advice.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: They did — you do not pour without a permit and a footing inspection. What they skip is asking the AHJ which holds they actually run.
permit_gate: should be on drawings before permit
permit_gate_notes: This phase IS the hold-point list. Confirm with AHJ / engineer. Not a stamp. Not legal advice. CMHC is Canadian / NBC — not IRC.
risk_if_swapped_late: Working ahead of a hold is a stop-work, not a save. Changing type after permit is a type change.
plain_language_summary: Paper first. Permit on the wall. Ask the AHJ which inspections they run and how much notice they want. ORNL wants a look after the hole and before the footing pour. CMHC is Canadian — do not copy their permit list as IRC. This is not a skip-inspection and it is not legal advice.
spanish_summary: Primero el papel. Permiso en la pared. Pregunte al AHJ qué inspecciones corre y con cuánto aviso. ORNL quiere ver el hueco antes de la zapata. CMHC es canadiense — no copie su lista como IRC. No es saltarse inspección ni consejo legal.
